items.title: New Found Glory’s Chad Gilbert Dead At 45
items.summary: Chad Gilbert, founding guitarist for the punk band New Found Glory, has died. "On the morning of September 20th, Chad Everett Gilbert passed away peacefully in his sleep," the band announced in a statement today. "He left this world surrounded by friends and family and took his final breaths with his wife and mother by his side, just as he wished." Gilbert revealed six months ago he had been diagnosed with brain cancer. He was 45. The post New Found Glory’s Chad Gilbert Dead At 45 appeared first on Stereogum .

items.summary: In May, NYC-based musician Grant Chapman, who's the percussionist for Chris Taylor's Body Meat , released the self-titled debut for his sample-based project Torture Methods. Torture Methods is a gothic, glitch-ridden nightmare — but one of those fun ones that plays out in the mind like a surrealist arthouse film. On Friday Sept. 18, Chapman returned with a new single "RIPPER, REAPER." The post Torture Methods – “RIPPER, REAPER” appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: 95-Year-Old William Shatner Debuts Metal Band At Riot Fest Aftershow
items.summary: New heavy metal enthusiast William Shatner and his metal band the *uckers made their debut on Sept. 19 at Park West in Chicago. Shatner and his band — composed of guitarists Marcus Nand and Britt Lightning, bassist Phil Soussan, and drummer Fred Achin — are performing today at Riot Fest on the Rebel Stage. But last night they performed a warm up gig for fans. The post 95-Year-Old William Shatner Debuts Metal Band At Riot Fest Aftershow appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Ed Sheeran Returns To The Stage With Speech About Israel And Palestine
items.summary: Ed Sheeran's tour has been in shambles this week after ousting tour opener Macklemore, who made pro-Palestinian remarks in New Jersey earlier this month. Following controversy over those MetLife Stadium shows, billionaire Robert Kraft, whose Kraft Group owns Gillette Stadium, where one of Sheeran's shows was set to take place, called for Macklemore to be kicked off the tour. The post Ed Sheeran Returns To The Stage With Speech About Israel And Palestine appeared first on Stereogum .
